text.en: Many shoppers appreciate the friendly and accommodating store associates at this Hialeah location, specifically naming staff members who guide customers to suitable supplies. However, other reviewers describe frustrating encounters at the counter, citing unhelpful responses when returning expired items and rude treatment when attempting to collect pickup orders.

Customers note that the store is clean and neatly organized, carrying a broad selection of food, treats, and pet gear for dogs and small animals. At the same time, several pet owners express disappointment over product quality, pointing out discontinued food brands as well as multiple instances of expired pet food and moldy treat bags found on the shelves.

Reviewers report notable communication problems, particularly when coordinating online orders or resolving merchandise complaints. Customers describe employees refusing to communicate through locked doors during early holiday closures despite pickup confirmation notices, while others note a lack of accountability when addressing expired food bags.

q.en: Does this store offer in-store pickup for online orders?

a.en: Yes, in-store pickup is available, though reviewers recommend confirming holiday store hours before arriving to pick up orders.

q.en: What kind of pet supplies are stocked at this location?

a.en: The store carries a variety of dog and cat food, treats, and everyday care accessories, though specific premium brands may occasionally rotate out.

q.en: Are employees available to help locate pet items?

a.en: Yes, several shoppers note that floor staff and cashiers readily assist with locating specific products and treats.

q.en: What should buyers check when purchasing pet food here?

a.en: Reviewers advise double-checking product expiration dates and treat bag seals before leaving the checkout counter.
